title: Nacogdoches County schools enroll 109 Asian students in 2024-25, up 11% over prior year
text:
Nacogdoches County schools enroll 109 Asian students in 2024-25, up 11% over prior year
Nacogdoches County school districts had 109 Asian students enrolled for the 2024-25 school year, representing an 11.2% increase from the prior year, according to the Texas Education Agency.
District data shows a total of 10,143 students enrolled across Nacogdoches County in 2024-25. Of that, Asian students represented 1.1% of the population, ranking as the third smallest ethnic group in these districts.
Of the eight public school districts in Nacogdoches County, Nacogdoches Independent School District had the largest enrollment of Asian students in 2024-25 at 71.
All district headquarters referenced in this report are based in cities within Nacogdoches County.
A WalletHub study released in 2026 listed Texas among the nation's least-educated states, placing it at 41st out of 50 for educational quality and student outcomes.
Texas operates the second-largest K-12 public school system in the country, serving around 5.5 million students and maintaining a student-to-teacher ratio near 15:1.
| District | % of Asian Students | Number of Asian Students | Total Enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nacogdoches ISD | 1.2 | 71 | 5,766 |
| Central Heights ISD | 2.2 | 24 | 1,096 |
| Woden ISD | 0.6 | 5 | 885 |
| Garrison ISD | 0.7 | 5 | 736 |
| Douglass ISD | 0.7 | 3 | 424 |
| Chireno ISD | 0.3 | 1 | 365 |
| Cushing ISD | 0 | 0 | 558 |
| Martinsville ISD | 0 | 0 | 313 |
Information in this report was sourced from the Texas Education Agency. Original data is available here.
